summary: Outputs string information exposed by a target operator, complementing numeric Info CHOP diagnostics with text-style details when available.

key_params.name: passive
key_params.note: Avoid forcing the target operator to cook while reading info

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Many operators expose no extra string information, so an empty or sparse table is valid.
Passive reads can avoid side effects but may return stale information until the target cooks.
Info DAT is different from Info CHOP, which exposes numeric channels rather than string rows.
Do not build logic that assumes specific row names unless the target operator type is known.
key_concepts: Displays string information exposed by a referenced operator.
The Operator parameter points to the node whose information table is queried.
Passive mode can avoid automatic recooking at the cost of possibly stale output.
Only some operators expose additional string information through Info DAT.
